name: social
description: Social media — profiles (one per persona) holding connections to Facebook, X, YouTube, Instagram, LinkedIn or any provider plugin; one set of posting tools; an Outbox that holds drafts for approval. Providers register through capabilities.social — the five built-ins do it the same way a plugin would.
author: sapphire

app.label: Social
app.description: Profiles, platform connections, and the Outbox

settings.label: New connections post as

options.label: Draft — she queues, you approve in the Outbox

settings.help: Each connection has its own switch; this is the default for new ones.

settings.label: Image drop folder (scp target)
settings.help: Instagram fetches images from a public URL. Images are copied here with scp (your ssh key) before posting.

settings.label: Image drop folder (public URL)
settings.help: Where the drop folder is served from.

social.label: Facebook Page

config_schema.label: Meta App ID
config_schema.help: developers.facebook.com → My Apps → your app → App ID. Name the app anything but 'Facebook'.

config_schema.label: Page
config_schema.help: Name or id of the Page to post as. Blank = the first Page you manage.

social.notes: Posts as a Page you manage (personal profiles cannot post by API). The Page token never expires.

social.label: X

config_schema.label: OAuth 2.0 Client ID
config_schema.help: developer.x.com → your app → Settings → User authentication settings → Set up (Read and write, Web App, the callback URI shown below). Only after that does Keys and tokens show the OAuth 2.0 Client ID.

config_schema.label: Client Secret
config_schema.help: Only for a confidential client; blank for a public one.

social.notes: Pay-per-use: the developer console bills per post and per read (no X Premium needed). X's rules want the Automated label: Settings and privacy → Your account → Account information → Automation, naming the human account; say it in the bio too.

social.label: YouTube

config_schema.label: Google Client ID
config_schema.help: console.cloud.google.com → APIs → Credentials → OAuth client (Web application). Enable the YouTube Data API v3.

social.notes: Comments on your videos and replies to them; channel numbers. No posting (API uploads stay private until Google audits the app). Set the consent screen to In production or the token dies in 7 days.

social.label: Instagram

config_schema.label: Meta App ID
config_schema.help: The same Meta app as Facebook.

config_schema.label: Facebook Page
config_schema.help: The Page your Instagram Business account is linked to. Blank = the first one.

social.notes: Business or Creator account linked to a Facebook Page. Every post needs an image at a public URL (the drop folder). Posts carry the AI label when disclosure is on.

social.label: LinkedIn

config_schema.label: LinkedIn Client ID
config_schema.help: linkedin.com/developers → your app → Auth. Add the products Share on LinkedIn and Sign In with LinkedIn using OpenID Connect.

social.notes: Posts to your personal profile. Write-only: no comments or mentions come back. The token lasts 60 days, then Connect again.
